lines: Kurenai and Mari were on the run through a back alleyー
Ugh, suddenly having to run made me even more drunk...  Mari, are you alright...?
U-Uhm... Kurenai-san... that's not me, it's a utility pole...
Maybe because she was still drunk and loopy, Kurenai had mistaken a utility pole for Mari.
Uwah, what am I doing... sorry. Are you alright though, Mari?
This time she had apparently mistaken a garbage can for Mari.
...I see. Maybe we'd better hide for a while until we sober up.
Not just Kurenai, but Mari as well was so tipsy that she could barely run.
Mari looked behind her, but there was no sign of the gangsters in the ally, most likely because the mercenaries were holding them back.
There should've been time to take a short breakー
Oh? And where are you going, you filthy Taimanin girls?
As if she had been waiting for them, a woman emerged from the darkness with her subordinates.
Meifeng from... the Kuron-kai, was it? She's something like the leader of those guys chasing after the djinn.
Yes, that's right! With that djinn's demonic power, our organization will be able to grow even more!
You two are hiding him, aren't you? We'll go easy on you this time, so why don't you just hand him over?
Hmph. We have no reason to help you villains... *hic!*
Are you drunk!? Fufu, I see... In that case, it might be quicker to just beat his hiding place out of you♪
Meifeng took out some old scrolls and unrolled them one after another. And thenー
A huge gate appeared in the air and a flame-clad demonic beast crawled out of it.
Summoning a demonic beast...? Are you some kind of witch?
Ahaha! Looks like you finally understood who you're up against, girls!?
The strongest witch in AmidaharaーIt is I, Meifeng the "White Serpent!!!"
With the gangsters and the flame beast in tow, the woman shouted as if her victory was assured.
!? Y-You drunkardsー! Salamander, teach them a lesson!!!
